model_family: descriptive OLS sensitivity with plant, site and season fixed effects plus FEve

mainland_realized_interaction_breadth.interpretation: No stable evidence that the FDQ-trait-matching association is stronger or weaker as a function of mainland realized interaction breadth.

mainland_corolla_tube_length.interpretation: A weak positive interaction estimate is not robust to site or plant omission and is not treated as a stable tube-length moderator.

dependency_reading: The positive community-level FDQ-to-trait-matching relationship is not currently explained by a stable moderator based on mainland realized interaction breadth or tube length. These moderators are source-native proxies for network breadth/morphology, not effective pollinator-dependency classes.
claim_boundary: Do not conclude that dependency has no effect. Direct effective-pollinator dependency is unresolved for the source-defined target set; the analysis only shows that two available source-native continuous moderators do not robustly explain FDQ-slope heterogeneity. Contemporary observational data cannot identify a historical dependency-by-boundary evolutionary effect.
